RC42 organizes and co-sponsors sessions at the [XXI ISA World Congress of Sociology](https://www.isa-sociology.org/en/conferences/world-congress/gwangju-2027), taking place July 4–10, 2027 in Gwangju, South Korea. Browse our sessions below, or see the [full program listing](https://isaconf.confex.com/isaconf/wc2027/webprogrampreliminary/Symposium924.html).
